title: Senior Product Engineer (Web Frontend)
description:
Why join us?

We’re on a mission to empower people with disabilities to do what they once did or never thought possible. As the world-leader in assistive communication solutions, we empower our customers to express themselves, connect with the world, and live richer lives.

At Tobii Dynavox, you can grow your career within a dynamic, global company that has a clear, impactful purpose - with the flexibility to also do what truly matters to you outside of work. What’s more, you’ll be part of a work culture where collaboration is the norm and individuality is welcomed.

As a member of our team, you’ll have the power to innovate for good. You’ll see your ideas in use in new applications, work with the latest technology on leading platforms, and deliver meaningful solutions for our customers.

We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer (Web Frontend) with strong React, Next.js and TypeScript expertise to join our Print Solutions team.

In this role, you'll work as part of a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts to create web experiences used by a global audience. You'll have the autonomy and trust to actively shape the end-to-end product experience, from user workflows and interactions to frontend architecture and engineering decisions.

We value engineering judgment over code output. As AI transforms how software is built, we look for engineers who can identify the right problems, shape intuitive product experiences, make sound architectural decisions, and use modern tools to deliver great solutions.

What you'll do

Develop and maintain web applications using React, Next.js and TypeScript
Drive technical design, architecture and frontend engineering decisions
Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities to improve usability, and work across disciplines to turn complex user needs into intuitive, effective product experiences.
Partner closely with product and design teams to create intuitive user experiences
Contribute to planning, prioritization and technical strategy
Explore new technologies and help evolve our AI-enabled engineering practices
Improve the quality, scalability and performance of our web applications
Support and elevate teams through knowledge sharing and technical leadership

What we're looking for

5+ years of professional software engineering experience
5+ years of experience with React and TypeScript
Experience building and operating SaaS products for a global audience
Strong understanding of modern web technologies, including APIs, authentication, caching, CDNs, SSR and PWA architectures
Experience with CI/CD, developer experience and application performance
Familiarity with accessibility and compliance requirements such as WCAG and GDPR
Experience using AI both in software development workflows and customer-facing solutions

Who you are

You combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative and pragmatic mindset. You're comfortable taking ownership of technical decisions while working closely with people across engineering, product and design.

You care about building quality software, understand the importance of great user experiences, and enjoy helping others grow through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

Location

This role is based in Stockholm, and we expect you to be in the office most days of the week.

Apply today!

We believe in empowering individuals - including our own employees - to reach their full potential. So, if you want to change lives while growing your own career, we’d love to hear from you.

Where we stand:

We believe diversity not only enriches our workplace culture, but also gives us a strategic advantage. Working with people from a variety of backgrounds and perspectives helps us all become better communicators, better problem solvers, and better human beings. Our differences make us stronger.

Tobii Dynavox values equality of opportunity, human dignity, and racial/ethnic and cultural diversity. Tobii Dynavox does not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, or national or ethnic origin.
